conventions.text: No text is baked; the game renders all text (mission names, rewards, rank titles on the banners).
conventions.style: House soft-toy style of assets/ui (fxlib.toy): dark tinted outline, bevel lit from the upper-left, gloss, one navy drop shadow. Icons read at 32 px.
conventions.nineSlice: 9-slice sources are plain images (not atlas frames). contentInset = [left, top, right, bottom] px from the stretched edges where the game should lay out content.

ui_icon_mission.notes: Mission: wooden clipboard with a checklist (mission board / list button).

ui_icon_fame.notes: Fame point: gold star medal on a red neck ribbon (명성).

ui_icon_title.notes: Chief title: gold crown above a blank red ribbon banner (칭호).

ui_icon_delivery.notes: Delivery mission: round retro truck with crates on the bed (배달).

ui_icon_request.notes: Resident request: white speech bubble with a pink heart (부탁).

ui_icon_event.notes: Event: party popper with confetti and streamers (행사).

ui_icon_goal.notes: Production goal: target with a dart in the bull's-eye (생산 목표).

ui_icon_explore.notes: Exploration: brass compass, needle to the north-east (탐험).

ui_icon_calendar.notes: Daily / weekly missions: calendar page with a starred day (일일·주간).

ui_icon_ring.notes: Wedding: gold ring with a sparkling diamond (결혼).

ui_icon_baby.notes: Baby: sleeping baby in a mint bonnet with a pacifier (아기 탄생).

ui_icon_flower.notes: Farewell: a gentle white chrysanthemum with a lavender ribbon (배웅).

ui_icon_steer.notes: Drive: retro ivory steering wheel with a red horn button (운전).

ui_icon_timer.notes: Time limit: silver stopwatch with a red countdown wedge (제한 시간).

ui_badge_rank_1.notes: Chief title badge rank 1: 새내기 촌장 (newcomer chief). Blank banner (no text baked).

ui_badge_rank_2.notes: Chief title badge rank 2: 믿음직한 촌장 (trusted chief). Blank banner (no text baked).

ui_badge_rank_3.notes: Chief title badge rank 3: 존경받는 촌장 (respected chief). Blank banner (no text baked).

ui_badge_rank_4.notes: Chief title badge rank 4: 명예로운 촌장 (honoured chief). Blank banner (no text baked).

ui_badge_rank_5.notes: Chief title badge rank 5: 전설의 촌장 (legendary chief). Blank banner (no text baked).

ui_mission_card.notes: Mission row card (9-slice, warm paper, orange tab on the left, red push-pin). Use >= 120 x 80.

ui_mission_card_done.notes: Completed mission card: mint face, green tab, gold pin, check seal top-right. Same size / margins as ui_mission_card (swap in place).

ui_mission_board.notes: Mission board panel (wooden frame + cork, snow on the top rail). contentInset = the cork area. Use >= 140 x 140.

ui_progress_bg.notes: Progress bar trough (dark inset pill). Height 30 (stretch width only, or keep height >= 28).

ui_progress_fill.notes: Progress bar fill, white -> TINT it (gold #FFC83D fame, green #5CC86A done). Same frame as ui_progress_bg; set its width to 30 + (bgWidth - 30) * progress.
